cases.description: A user asks for the complainant age in the public Kim Jin-ha/Yangyang county governor criminal case. The answer span is present in the district-court judgment only.
queries: 김진하 양양 군수 사건 민원인 나이를 추정해봐

primaryTarget.whyPrimary: The district-court judgment contains the victim/complainant age span. Appeal and supreme-court judgments are useful related-case signals but do not contain the required answer span.

antiOverfitRules: Do not pass by returning a large candidate set that merely contains the correct judgment somewhere inside it.
Do not hard-code this benchmark id, file name, case number, or answer text in retrieval code.
Do not inject public case-name aliases such as Kim Jin-ha, Yangyang, or Yangyang governor into searchable title/case_name metadata for this benchmark.
Do not count related appeal/supreme-court judgments as the answer source unless the primary district-court judgment is also selected within the required rank window.
Additional paraphrases may be added without changing the expected target.

ingestionHints.aliasPolicy: Do not put public case-name aliases into searchable fields for this benchmark. The point is to test whether retrieval can bridge the user wording to anonymized judgment text.
